_comment: Copy to config/<tenant>.json and adjust. Credentials are NOT stored here: set SAIL_BASE_URL, SAIL_CLIENT_ID and SAIL_CLIENT_SECRET (a PAT of an ORG_ADMIN) in the environment or in the .env file named below.
